departures.name: David Liniewski
departures.note: Entry 2008. Absent 2013-14, not on alumni list. Exit 2012 or 2013 (2012-13 unobserved). Phase 2: no PubMed papers, no page on any Loyola host; NPPES lists 'Dawid Liniewski' with Neurological Surgery taxonomy and a Maywood address (enumerated 2008, i.e. at residency start; not evidence of outcome). Outcome unknown; no training_history row added.

departures.name: Drew Spencer
departures.note: Entry 2010. TRANSFERRED to McGaw/Northwestern (program 41): not on the Northwestern roster in any capture through 2016-05-12, listed there as PGY7 from 2016-08-01; Northwestern alumni 2017. Left Loyola at end of 2015-16 (PGY6). training_history: program 34 completed='no', departure_type='transferred', end_year 2016; program 41 transfer-in row start_year 2016 (PGY7).

departures.name: Tarik Ibrahim
departures.note: Entry 2010. DIED during residency, summer 2016, with one year left (TIGER fund page; CV residency 7/2010-8/2016; posthumous certificate 2016-08-03; alumni page lists him under 2016). Separate outcome: training_history row changed to completed='no', notes='died during training', no departure_type. Count as neither completion nor attrition. NOTE: 16_adjudicate prints him as 'LEFT -> did not complete' because it has no 'died' category; downstream analysis must key on notes='died during training'.

problems: No full roster exists in Wayback or Common Crawl for 2012-13, 2015-18, 2020-22 or 2023-24; these years are reconstructed, with partial observations from the awards page. All CC crawls have now completed (the two phase-1 failures were retried, 0 records). 16_adjudicate has no 'died' outcome: Ibrahim prints as 'LEFT -> did not complete' though training_history marks him notes='died during training'. programs.website points to the NEUROLOGY residency page; correct URL is https://www.loyolamedicine.org/gme/residencies/neurosurgery. Drew Spencer transfer-in row was added to training_history for program 41 (per brief step 9).

2011-2012.reason: stritch node/6 (2013-07 capture, content dated Aug 2011), full roster.

2012-2013.reason: No roster capture anywhere; all 10 bracketed or alumni-confirmed; 2011 class (1) seen as PGY1 in 2011-12, 2012 class (Johans, Swong) full at 2. Only Liniewski's exit year (2012 vs 2013) is unresolved; his departure is recorded either way.

2015-2016.reason: All 11 residents of 2014-15 accounted for (2 alumni 2016, Ibrahim died summer 2016 per TIGER page/CV, Spencer placed at Loyola until Northwestern took him at PGY7 Aug 2016, rest bracketed); 2015 class (Jusue Torres, Zakaria) full at 2.

2016-2017.reason: Everyone bracketed 2014-15/2018-19 or alumni-confirmed; no known resident can have left; 2016 class of 1 (Kim) matches the program's stated 1/2 alternation (2015: 2, 2017: 2).

2017-2018.reason: Bracketed; Jusue Torres observed via awards page (2018 TIGER); 2017 class (Simon, Iordanou) full at 2.

2020-2021.reason: 4 observed on awards page (2021 recipients), 5 bracketed, Jani/Ng added as PGY1 (med-school affiliations Pitt/Tufts through 2020, PGY3 2022-23). All classes full (2) or seen alone on observed rosters (2018 class).

2021-2022.reason: 3 observed on awards page (2022 recipients; Jani bio '2021-2022 Shea Award'), rest bracketed; Frazzetta added as PGY1 (Stritch student through 2021). Residual: 2021 class of 1 could in principle have had an unseen second intern who left within the year; class sizes 2020-2026 alternate 2/1, consistent with 1.

2023-2024.reason: 3 observed on awards page (2024 recipients), 7 bracketed, Choe added as PGY1 (Stritch MD, PGY2 2024-25). 2023 class of 1 fits the 2/1 alternation (2022: 2, 2024: 2).
